Greatmark Investment Partners Has Boosted Its Target (TGT) Position by $6.26 Million; Market Value Rose; Adams Asset Advisors Has Trimmed American Eagle Outfitrs (AEO) Stake as Shares Rose
May 1, 2018 - By Darrin Black
Greatmark Investment Partners Inc increased its stake in Target Corp (TGT) by 12035% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc bought 96,280 shares as the company’s stock rose 4.77% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 97,080 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $6.33M, up from 800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Greatmark Investment Partners Inc who had been investing in Target Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $38.54B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.49% or $1.08 during the last trading session, reaching $71.52. About 3.73M shares traded. Target Corporation (NYSE:TGT) has risen 28.46% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 16.91% the S&P500.
Adams Asset Advisors Llc decreased its stake in American Eagle Outfitrs (AEO) by 10.62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Adams Asset Advisors Llc sold 59,484 shares as the company’s stock rose 3.61% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 500,864 shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $9.42M, down from 560,348 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Adams Asset Advisors Llc who had been investing in American Eagle Outfitrs for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $3.60 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.31% or $0.27 during the last trading session, reaching $20.41. About 3.42M shares traded. American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) has risen 39.60% since May 1, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 28.05% the S&P500.
Among 29 analysts covering Target Corporation ( NYSE:TGT ), 11 have Buy rating, 3 Sell and 15 Hold. Therefore 38% are positive. Target Corporation had 89 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Outperform” rating by Robert W. Baird on Wednesday, February 14. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank on Monday, August 17 with “Hold”. JP Morgan maintained the shares of TGT in report on Thursday, May 19 with “Neutral” rating. The rating was maintained by Goldman Sachs on Friday, May 20 with “Neutral”. Piper Jaffray maintained the stock with “Overweight” rating in Thursday, February 4 report. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Thursday, November 17 by Telsey Advisory Group. The firm has “Neutral” rating by UBS given on Thursday, November 19. As per Wednesday, October 18, the company rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus. The stock has “Hold” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Thursday, July 13. The firm has “Peer Perform” rating given on Friday, April 29 by Wolfe Research.
Greatmark Investment Partners Inc, which manages about $285.51 million and $275.91 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Carbo Ceramics Inc (NYSE:CRR) by 34,025 shares to 15,975 shares, valued at $163,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ensco Plc (NYSE:ESV) by 137,650 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 187,475 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Among 29 analysts covering American Eagle Outfitters ( NYSE:AEO ), 15 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 12 Hold. Therefore 52% are positive. American Eagle Outfitters had 96 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Peer Perform” rating by Wolfe Research given on Thursday, March 2. The stock of American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) earned “Buy” rating by BMO Capital Markets on Wednesday, July 5. Citigroup initiated the shares of AEO in report on Wednesday, October 7 with “Neutral” rating. BMO Capital Markets downgraded American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) on Wednesday, April 27 to “Market Perform” rating. The stock of American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) has “Mkt Perform” rating given on Thursday, December 1 by FBR Capital. As per Tuesday, August 15, the company rating was upgraded by FBR Capital. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, November 13 by RBC Capital Markets. Wunderlich maintained the shares of AEO in report on Saturday, August 15 with “Hold” rating. The stock of American Eagle Outfitters, Inc. (NYSE:AEO) earned “Buy” rating by FBR Capital on Friday, December 15. Citigroup maintained the stock with “Neutral” rating in Thursday, August 18 report.
Adams Asset Advisors Llc, which manages about $828.72M and $812.76M US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Simon Property Group (NYSE:SPG) by 3,480 shares to 7,561 shares, valued at $1.30M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Universal Corp Va (NYSE:UVV) by 47,963 shares in the quarter, for a total of 148,619 shares, and has risen its stake in Nustar Energy (NYSE:NS). Darrin Black
